component.name: suanPan
component.summary: 🧮 An Open Source, Parallel and Heterogeneous Finite Element Analysis Framework

description.p: suanPan is a powerful finite element method (FEM) simulation platform for solid mechanics, civil engineering, structural engineering and earthquake engineering. It combines a fast modern C++ core with a flexible, command-driven modelling language, making it suitable for research, teaching and demanding engineering analysis.

From small validation models to large-scale nonlinear simulations, suanPan brings analysis procedures, element formulations, material models and high-performance solvers together in one integrated, cross-platform application.
description.heading: Analysis capabilities

ul.li: Static and nonlinear static analysis
Dynamic and seismic analysis with implicit and explicit time integration
Arc-length continuation and collapse analysis
Frequency, eigenvalue and buckling analysis
Structural optimization workflows
Response spectrum and single-degree-of-freedom response tools

description.heading: Extensive modelling library

ul.li: Beam, truss, membrane, plate, shell, solid, contact, joint, embedded, mass and spring elements
Elastic, plastic, damage, viscoelastic, hysteretic, orthotropic and geotechnical material models
Metal plasticity, concrete damage, soil and user-defined constitutive models
Structural, fibre and NM section models with code-based design support
Constraints for multi-point connections, rigid walls, embedding, gaps and particle collision
A rich collection of load types, recorders and analysis steps

description.heading: High performance

ul.li: Shared-memory parallelism with Intel TBB
Distributed-memory parallelism with MPI for cluster simulations
Optional GPU acceleration with CUDA and MAGMA
Optimized sparse direct solvers and linear algebra backends, including Intel oneMKL, OpenBLAS and AOCL
Native builds for Linux, Windows and macOS on both AMD64 and ARM64

description.heading: Productive modelling

ul.li: Clear, human-readable, command-based input files
Interactive console with a guided overview introduction
Batch analysis with suanPan -f model.sp
VTK output for post-processing and visualization in ParaView
Variables, macros and mathematical expressions for reusable models
Extensive examples, a searchable online manual and a VS Code extension with syntax highlighting and autocompletion

description.heading: Ideal for

ul.li: Researchers developing and validating numerical models and algorithms
Civil, structural and earthquake engineers performing nonlinear analysis
Educators and students learning finite element methods
Engineers working with material calibration, contact, buckling, dynamics and optimization
